roles.hook: Grabs attention in the first second: strong motion, reveal, face, surprise. Opens a reel.
roles.a-roll: Main footage that carries the story: talking to camera, the key action.
roles.b-roll: Supporting cutaway: details, scenery, hands, process, establishing shots.
roles.thumbnail: Would make a good cover or thumbnail: clear face or bold simple frame.
roles.brand: Logo, wordmark, product packshot or graphic to overlay.
roles.reject: Blurry, shaky, badly exposed, accidental, or a worse take of another clip.
